newsitem.title: UK: Another explosion in Northern Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Another explosion in Northern Ireland.

text.p: An explosion went off under a car in the Northern Ireland port of Larne on Monday but no one was reported injured.
Police said it appeared that a bomb exploded under a parked car. The area was sealed off and army bomb disposal experts were brought in.
Larne is a predominantly Protestant town on the coast north of the Northern Ireland capital, Belfast.
Earlier on Monday suspected IRA guerrillas hurled a bomb at a police station in the Short Strand area of east Belfast but no one was hurt.

Police believe the Irish Republican Army (IRA) which is fighting to end British rule of Northern Ireland, is intent on killing a member of the security forces to provoke retaliation by Protestant Loyalists, who want the province to stay British.
